[TEAM & FOUNDERS]: Integrations are scoped to the person who connected them. Gini acts with a user’s access only on explicit instruction, and read-only tools cannot write.
[INTEGRATIONS & ECOSYSTEM]: TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest. Integration credentials are described as stored in a separate vault with per-tenant keys.
